notes.title: Festive Winter Season! Panic Mode Winter Update - 0.3.12.0
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40312635/349697e9a9456a42d13f4e5036c9e721f46eae87.jpg[/img]

[h1]Happy festive season to all pammies and unpaid crisis management interns![/h1]


We managed to stack up quite a to-do list after Gamescom earlier this year thanks to all of the feedback, since then we've been keeping busy in building both new content and working through our bug list. Although we've still got a few things that we're still working on, we're excited to share the stuff we've got ready - including [b]three new levels[/b] and a new tool, the [b]Wrecking Ball[/b]! Here's hoping you'll enjoy and thanks again to everyone for all the feedback over the year.

Wishing you all a productive and efficient festive season!

[h3]Seasons Greetings from all of the MobiusCode Team[/h3]



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40312635/5e4ddcc0081a7121e517a0d6ecdc717c8343844b.jpg[/img]



[h1]Panic Mode – Update 0.3.12.0[/h1]
(Released on 21.12.22)



[h3]New Stuff[/h3]
* Three new properties need evacuation protocols, including a festive one
* Wrecking Ball tool - for more precise wanton destruction
* Smoke Pipe - Broken black industrial pipes now emit smoke
* Snow Pammy - Warning: melts very easily

[h3]Changes[/h3]
* Reintroduced air purifier item
* Tweaked pammy speed and 'fast forward'


[h3]UI/UX-Changes[/h3]
* Items placed by the player are now highlighted while placing additional items or using the eraser
* Arrows are now on top of directional items
* New UI icons and replacement ones for the Toolbar

[h3]Bug-Fixes[/h3]
* Bomberator fixes
* Fixed issues with long loading times introduced in last patch
* Fixed pammy behaviour causing them to be a bit [i]too [/i]stupid at times; even by their standards.

notes.title: Resounding feedback, resounding alarms! Panic Mode - Update 0.2.9
notes.content:
Thanks to everyone for the feedback since the bigger update this summer! In the spirit of making more frequent smaller updates going forward, here's a few things we've been working on.

----------------------------
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40312635/fa904394c86116b888a92334f594463d17af6850.gif[/img]

[h1]Panic Mode – Update 0.2.9.0[/h1]
(Released on 12.08.22)

[h3]General-Changes[/h3]
* Destruction feature – Alerts & alarms (Speaker & Smoke Alarm) now propagate through destroyed walls
* Smaller Bugfixes

[h3]UI/UX-Changes[/h3]
* Menu exit through click - clicking outside of the menu closes it
* Visual Alerts - a fancy new overlay now visualizes alarm behaviour

[h3]Level-Changes[/h3]
* Minor Visual adjustments to some levels
* Two awesome new levels - try them out!

----------------------------

There's still a whole backlog of things to work on, if you'd like to help prioritise what we work on next join us on [url=https://discord.gg/aJSTxqHVZ3]Discord[/url] where you'll find a link to where tickets are voted on.

Also, anyone attending [b]Devcom[/b] and/or [b]Gamescom[/b] this year, do stop by! More details on where you can visit us in our next update and on our Discord.

Cheers!

notes.title: Pamperümpel Industries Needs You! [New Update Live]
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=87ahgnHjmNk;full][/previewyoutube]

Human interns have requested significant changes to the “Pamperümpel Safety System.exe” software, the corporate issued remote login application that allows earthlings to build safety protocols to save employees on another planet - find below some changes:

-More properties have been built and require evacuation protocols (new levels, like)
- Initial safety management training has been improved (revised tutorial)
- Pamperümpel Industries now produces new consumer products and resources:
[list]
[*] Explosives
[*] Freezeables
[*] Recyclable (burnable) trash
[*]…and many more!
[/list]

- Corporate supervisors have been upgraded with a nearly noticeable amount of empathy
- The city and districts have grown with only minor pollution to the environment
The home screen now shows a clearer world map
Properties include some surrounding decoration based on the district

- Pammy workers have received new training, including having a better understanding of what fire is and slightly fewer erratic behaviours

- Camera controls have been totally revised
- The software has received some input upgrades
[list]
[*] You can now submit reports and suggestions directly
[*] Help texts are now available
[*] More tasks will be asked of you at properties
[*] Item descriptions now available on the toolbar
[*] Buttons are shinier
[*] Who needs payment after completing your work when you have confetti?
[*] Pammy names and health are now clearer
[*] The software is now more compatible with different hardware
[/list]

notes.title: Upcoming Features & Improvements for Panic Mode
notes.content:
It’s been a while since our last update and we’re excited to talk a bit more about what we’re working on - here's what we have in store for you for one of the upcoming updates:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40312635/801317fa2c6b2dab8af4b3999b3945f41c9f4038.png[/img]

Interior walls and objects (and pammies) will soon be able to get exploded by certain items. Who needs to strategically plan escape routes when you can blast open a few walls?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40312635/9c674fb4a5e451965154d20438b9bd8db037a44b.gif[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40312635/6d70ccea36fca94f04bb2fb0fcf1347db9bd0ca9.png[/img]
Crisis employees will soon be able to zoom, rotate, and pan to get a better look at the situations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40312635/082875f2175c85b61603b3cec15e5daea2f46411.png[/img]
Confused about which item does what thing, about how to reset items, or about existence in general? We’re working on answering some of those questions with a totally new tutorial.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40312635/f8b5eb8d0092ea0132e05a756b69ed700d60a3f0.png[/img]
Also in the works is a cool new element - Ice forms when water freezes (who knew?) causing blocked paths or stopping Pammies in their tracks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40312635/489daa197b762dc96753900956c067f38ed28984.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40312635/b3e646790955f416eb555bab73b3a12bd76af535.png[/img]
There’s a world of difference (sorry) between our old and upcoming world maps:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40312635/f370861757ee69b5c009f04de177afb17aecfb7a.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40312635/776a290a3d0e1ab94ccce681f51b47878e0d404d.png[/img]
Shinier buttons and colours, highlighting things, and some general refinements are also on the way.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40312635/0a6516ee0c5e227544df9b81ce34754ae36e5c0b.png[/img]
We’re making use of the new mechanics to develop new accident-prone situations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40312635/c835ebb34b4d9627c92e4c39e029bc482b82b49b.png[/img]
Upcoming improvements to the game's aesthetic include new room decor and outfits along with some improvements to the heat vision and such.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40312635/3850872f9132ece52f662c3e525e1f64b72194a9.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40312635/91f62c9f794ae3c6b4e2bd2de329c716e0dad49f.png[/img]
What’s that? Who knows. In any case this is apparently a very handy thing to do to prepare ourselves for future goals like enhancing objective progression or potentially a level editor.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40312635/79f15d6b68c367c1753c22aea906c8d8b9073774.png[/img]
We've had a list of things to tidy up that hopefully won't grow too big during the next phases of testing. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40312635/ec67380b8ded459346a8b15963869c9ad47d3d40.png[/img]
We'll roll out some of the updates in late January pending tester feedback. 


Finally a big thanks for the support and feedback throughout the development so far, the feedback from our earliest builds right through to recent playtests has helped us make much better decisions during task planning which will hopefully result in a much better experience. If you’re interested in becoming a beta tester or to let us know your feedback we'd love to hear your from you on our discord here: 

[url=https://discord.gg/aJSTxqHVZ3]Panic Mode Discord[/url]

notes.title: Bugfix: Aluminum Foil Removal
notes.content: We noticed that for some players some walls looked like they were made of aluminum foil. This was due to a faulty texture and was now corrected.

notes.title: What's in the Early Access version?
notes.content:
Greetings employees of Pamperümpel Industries,

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40312635/6472ec23ca8d4b3b68f45349398ffce1d8b037ae.gif[/img]

Thanks for taking a look at our game - the feedback we've received so far has helped refine the direction. We know what we're showing is very, very early although based on the success of the feedback thus far we've decided to open the project up to community earlier than originally planned. The major points we're taking on board before the Early Access Alpha is that the difficulty needs to be higher and a few UI tweaks - do let us know your feedback or ideas either in the survey or below!
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40312635/4b98deba588e7654b9005af16358bb481b2c74da.png[/img]

We're approaching the finish line in preparing our Early Access Alpha version [b](July 9)[/b], which we hope will give a better feeling for what the game is about at the moment rather than the more technical/gameplay oriented demo. The improvements between the demo version and the early access version are as follows:
[list]
[*] First biome - Pamperümpel's City
[*] 10 levels
[*] Elements: Fire, Water, Smoke
[*] Pammies and Pammy variations
[*] Objectives within levels
[*] Updated level select
[*] Upgraded UI - planning phase
[*] Improved tutorials for first-time users
[*] Improved UI for demonstrating the level's hazard
[*] Pamperumpel employee rankwill improve based on performance
[*] 5-7 placable crisis tool items (for now!)
[/list]

_________________________________________________________

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40312635/06de1dbdd2de5c42b33a3f092e19c2c7110bfcba.png[/img]
We have had a bunch of ideas that had to be put aside to stick to our scope though should we secure the means to continue, here's a rough look at what would be to come from alpha to a full release:

[h3]Destruction[/h3]
Obliterating walls to create paths for Pammies - not the safest option!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40312635/5efcb30f7828010713f6e803f0ec35dae26060d0.gif[/img]

[h3]Wiring [/h3]
Linking up items based on signals and available electricity

[h3]Utilities[/h3]
Allowing the player the ability to control the water and air in an office building

[h3]New Elements[/h3]
After fire/smoke and water, we're planning to introduce electricity and a mouldy mushroom element that causes the Pammies to zombify

[h3]Level Creator[/h3]
By popular demand the level creator has made its way into the roadmap before our previously planned biomes. We'd love to develop something to enable a sandbox mode

[h3]Pammy Behaviour Upgrades[/h3]
More smart yet more stupid. We'd love to explore the interactions between Pammies, work routines, variations of their decision making, and more item and elemental interactions.

[h3]Revised Economy[/h3]
Rethinking how a player could earn items and adding extra dimensions to what happens to the Pammies after they've been saved

[h3]New Biomes[/h3]
What other parts of this planet might the Pammies be inhabiting - we're interested in exploring new hazards that impact every level in a series and the corresponding items to counter them

[h3]More Levels[/h3]
A wider variety of levels with more difficulty - approximately 10-15 per biome

[h3]More Lore & Prettier Things[/h3]
The different biomes and level surroundings would get upgraded and lots more decorative items added to the game.

[url=https://discord.gg/PyXnExbxzv][/url][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40312635/2df69fb6a84beca3586c9f55d7ec69812e271fea.png[/img][/url]

[url=https://forms.office.com/Pages/ResponsePage.aspx?id=XJjQVv0pMkmlLfnRpRVRLunliv_rJIJDiADgziRWytdUQlpVQUpUTTI4QzcyRzFNSjFSRktTQ0NNUS4u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40312635/c8f42ee1629f9cce4fa014446fdaa45d5bd8c6c0.png[/img][/url]

If you'd like to give us any feedback or thoughts do visit our discord or drop us a comment below - Likewise here's an anonymous survey. We're looking forward to see what you all think!

Thank you for your continued loyalty,
Pamperumpel Industries Employee#25
